order_note: No predecessor. SQL 170 creates one table and two functions and replaces nothing (owner 2026-11-19: app notifications when signatures are received, funds are disbursed or received, the wallet changes, or a message arrives; the app side is PR 2016, src/lib/nativePush.ts, which asks permission after sign-in and sends the phone's push token to the API). public.device_push_tokens (id, user_id, platform ios or android, token unique, created_at, last_seen_at; RLS on, no policy, every non-owner grant revoked, default privileges included, as SQL 118 and SQL 158) and two SECURITY DEFINER functions, search_path public, row_security off, EXECUTE checksops and the owner: aws_push_register_device(text, text) (the signed-in user, auth.uid(), registers a token; a token registered by another user moves to the caller; at most 20 per user, the least recently seen dropped beyond that; returns the row id) and aws_push_unregister_device(text) (removes only the caller's own token; returns whether a row was removed). The file refuses (55000) sql170_prerequisite_missing (auth.uid(), gen_random_uuid(), role checksops) and sql170_unexpected_table (a device_push_tokens table with other columns); a table with these columns but another shape is refused by the engine (created_tables_absent_or_intended). The applying login owns the new table and functions (created_tables_owned_by_login, functions_owned_by_login). No existing table, column, constraint, trigger, policy, grant or row changes; nothing reads the tokens or sends a notification yet: sending is a later, separate step with its own review. Expected pre-state in both environments: the table and both functions absent (release sql170 v1: 18bfd4fd6f59df48cc41b1058fddf1d3ca9334fe46b6547f3de87c9920a4db32, releaseStateHash('sql170', {})). No API, Lambda or SPA change is part of this pin.
